basic_profile.bio: A gaming enthusiast from Seattle, WA, who has been on Reddit for nearly a decade. I work as a software developer specializing in game development, which aligns perfectly with my passion for indie games. I enjoy testing new game mechanics and exploring game lore, particularly in titles like Undertale. I'm a night owl and usually online after midnight, sharing insights and tips with fellow gamers. Single, but I enjoy the company of my two cats, who often keep me entertained during long coding sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and a minor in Game Design, I've spent years honing my skills in coding and game mechanics. My expertise is a blend of formal education and countless hours of self-teaching through online courses and community contributions. I actively engage in forums and subreddits related to game development and indie games, continually updating my knowledge.
